title: Change manifest
description: Every pull request one release carries, with the time of its first commit, its own lifecycle, and the release pull request that cut the release. Written by `conventions release changes` while the release is still a draft, so it ships inside the release's contracts bundle. The deploying repository reads it to measure DORA change lead time.

repository.description: The repository that cut the release, as OWNER/NAME.

path.description: The release-please package path the release covers, `.` for the repository root. Changes are the pull requests whose merge commit touches it.

version.description: The released version, without the tag's prefix.

previous_tag.description: The highest earlier tag of the same package. Null for a package's first release.

commit.description: The commit the tag names: the squash commit of the release pull request.

generator.description: What wrote the file, for example `engineering-conventions 0.10.0`.

created_at.description: When release-please first opened the pull request. It is reused and refreshed for every later change, so this can predate a change.

refreshed_at.description: Every force-push to the pull request's head, oldest first.

changes.description: One entry per pull request in (previous_tag, tag] whose merge commit touches `path`, newest merge first. The release pull request itself is not one.

time.description: An RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, as GitHub reports it.

listed.description: Whether the version's changelog section lists the pull request (by its commit link, or by its `#N` when no link resolves). The listed ones are the release's releasable changes.

type.description: The Conventional Commits type of the squash commit's subject, null when it has none.

breaking.description: A `!` before the subject's colon, or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` / `BREAKING-CHANGE:` footer.

author_kind.description: Who opened the pull request, by kind only, never by login: `agent` for a coding agent's App (musher-dagger), `dependency-bot` for Dependabot and Renovate, `automation` for any other App or bot, `human` otherwise.

sha.description: The pull request's commit with the earliest author date.

at.description: When the change started: `authored_at`, or the pull request's `created_at` when that is earlier (`rewritten`).

rewritten.description: The earliest author date is after the pull request opened, so its history was rewritten after it opened.

truncated.description: The pull request has more commits than the 250 GitHub returns, so an earlier one may be missing.

release_pull_request_opened_at.description: When the release pull request first carried this change: its creation, or its first refresh, at or after the change merged.
